Users want to duplicate an episode, to try another take without losing the original.

report.answer: I added `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore`, and the message shown after deleting an episode now has an Undo button, in English and Korean. All 19 backend tests pass (6 new), and the frontend type-check is clean with no new lint problems. A restored episode comes back with its cuts at the number it had when deleted, and the episodes from there on move down one place. If the project now has fewer episodes than that, it goes at the end. Anyone outside the workspace gets a 404 `NOT_FOUND_EPISODE`. Restoring an episode that isn't deleted returns it unchanged, so clicking Undo twice does no harm. To show the Undo button I added an optional action button to the shared toaster. The delete messages that were hard-coded in English now come from the translation files. Not changed: the existing delete endpoint still doesn't check workspace membership, so a non-member who knows an episode's id can delete it but can't restore it.

+"""
+Keeps a project's live (not deleted) episodes numbered 1, 2, 3... with no
+gaps or repeats. Every code path that adds or removes an episode goes through
+these helpers.
+"""
+from typing import List
+from uuid import UUID
+
+from sqlmodel import Session, select
+
+from app.models import Episode, Project
+
+
+def _lock_project(session: Session, project_id: UUID) -> None:
+    # Serialises concurrent reorderings of the same project (no-op on SQLite).
+    session.exec(select(Project).where(Project.id == project_id).with_for_update()).first()
+
+
+def _renumber(session: Session, project_id: UUID) -> List[Episode]:
+    episodes = session.exec(
+        select(Episode)
+        .where(Episode.project_id == project_id)
+        .where(Episode.deleted_at == None)  # noqa: E711
+        .order_by(Episode.episode_order, Episode.created_at, Episode.id)
+    ).all()
+    for i, ep in enumerate(episodes, start=1):
+        if ep.episode_order != i:
+            ep.episode_order = i
+            session.add(ep)
+    return list(episodes)
+
+
+def normalize(session: Session, project_id: UUID) -> None:
+    """Close any gaps (e.g. after a delete). Caller commits."""
+    _lock_project(session, project_id)
+    _renumber(session, project_id)
+
+
+def make_room(session: Session, project_id: UUID, position: int | None = None) -> int:
+    """
+    Return the number a new episode should take at `position` (clamped to
+    1..n+1; None appends) and shift the episodes from there on down one place.
+    The caller adds the new episode with that number and commits.
+    """
+    _lock_project(session, project_id)
+    episodes = _renumber(session, project_id)
+    last = len(episodes) + 1
+    position = last if position is None else max(1, min(position, last))
+    for ep in episodes[position - 1:]:
+        ep.episode_order += 1
+        session.add(ep)
+    return position

@@ -0,0 +1,98 @@
+from tests.conftest import signup
+
+API = "/api/v1"
+
+
+def _project(client, h, title="Night Bus"):
+    r = client.post(f"{API}/projects", headers=h, json={"title": title, "genres": []})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()["id"]
+
+
+def _episode(client, h, pid, title, order):
+    r = client.post(f"{API}/episodes", headers=h, json={"title": title, "project_id": pid, "episode_order": order})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+
+
+def _listed(client, h, pid):
+    return [(e["title"], e["episode_order"]) for e in
+            client.get(f"{API}/episodes", headers=h, params={"project_id": pid}).json()]
+
+
+def _setup(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid = _project(client, h)
+    eps = [_episode(client, h, pid, t, i) for i, t in enumerate(["A", "B", "C", "D"], start=1)]
+    return h, pid, eps
+
+
+def test_restore_brings_episode_back_at_its_place_with_its_cuts(client):
+    h, pid, eps = _setup(client)
+    b = eps[1]
+    for i, script in enumerate(["one", "two"], start=1):
+        r = client.post(f"{API}/cuts", headers=h, json={"episode_id": b["id"], "cut_order": i, "script": script})
+        assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    cuts_before = client.get(f"{API}/cuts", headers=h, params={"episode_id": b["id"]}).json()
+
+    assert client.delete(f"{API}/episodes/{b['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    assert _listed(client, h, pid) == [("A", 1), ("C", 2), ("D", 3)]
+    assert client.get(f"{API}/cuts", headers=h, params={"episode_id": b["id"]}).json() == []
+
+    r = client.post(f"{API}/episodes/{b['id']}/restore", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert r.json()["id"] == b["id"]
+    assert r.json()["episode_order"] == 2
+    assert _listed(client, h, pid) == [("A", 1), ("B", 2), ("C", 3), ("D", 4)]
+    assert client.get(f"{API}/episodes/{b['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 200
+    assert client.get(f"{API}/cuts", headers=h, params={"episode_id": b["id"]}).json() == cuts_before
+
+
+def test_restore_after_other_changes_keeps_numbering_contiguous(client):
+    h, pid, eps = _setup(client)
+    a, b, c, d = eps
+    client.delete(f"{API}/episodes/{c['id']}", headers=h)   # C had place 3
+    client.delete(f"{API}/episodes/{a['id']}", headers=h)   # A had place 1
+    assert _listed(client, h, pid) == [("B", 1), ("D", 2)]
+
+    client.post(f"{API}/episodes/{c['id']}/restore", headers=h)  # back to place 3 = end
+    assert _listed(client, h, pid) == [("B", 1), ("D", 2), ("C", 3)]
+    client.post(f"{API}/episodes/{a['id']}/restore", headers=h)
+    assert _listed(client, h, pid) == [("A", 1), ("B", 2), ("D", 3), ("C", 4)]
+
+
+def test_restore_beyond_the_end_appends(client):
+    h, pid, eps = _setup(client)
+    d = eps[3]
+    client.delete(f"{API}/episodes/{d['id']}", headers=h)
+    client.delete(f"{API}/episodes/{eps[0]['id']}", headers=h)
+    client.post(f"{API}/episodes/{d['id']}/restore", headers=h)
+    assert _listed(client, h, pid) == [("B", 1), ("C", 2), ("D", 3)]
+
+
+def test_restoring_a_live_episode_changes_nothing(client):
+    h, pid, eps = _setup(client)
+    r = client.post(f"{API}/episodes/{eps[1]['id']}/restore", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200
+    assert r.json()["episode_order"] == 2
+    assert _listed(client, h, pid) == [("A", 1), ("B", 2), ("C", 3), ("D", 4)]
+
+
+def test_non_member_gets_404(client):
+    h, pid, eps = _setup(client)
+    client.delete(f"{API}/episodes/{eps[1]['id']}", headers=h)
+    other = signup(client, email="stranger@example.com")
+    r = client.post(f"{API}/episodes/{eps[1]['id']}/restore", headers=other)
+    assert r.status_code == 404
+    assert r.json()["code"] == "NOT_FOUND_EPISODE"
+    assert _listed(client, h, pid) == [("A", 1), ("C", 2), ("D", 3)]
+    # Same answer for live episodes and ids that never existed.
+    assert client.post(f"{API}/episodes/{eps[0]['id']}/restore", headers=other).status_code == 404
+    r = client.post(f"{API}/episodes/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/restore", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 404
+    assert r.json()["code"] == "NOT_FOUND_EPISODE"
+
+
+def test_requires_auth(client):
+    h, pid, eps = _setup(client)
+    assert client.post(f"{API}/episodes/{eps[0]['id']}/restore").status_code == 401
